summary: The filing is an 8-K reporting quarterly earnings and a newly declared $0.25 per share quarterly cash dividend (Item 8.01). The dividend is payable August 28, 2026 to shareholders of record September 28, 2026. No price per share, premium, or advisor is mentioned as this is not a transaction. The dividend represents a capital return to shareholders. No activist, acquisition, or restructuring elements are present. The event is ordinary—routine dividend declaration—though it constitutes a capital return. Watch for sustainability of cash flow to support future dividends; no arbitrage angle exists.
